_comment: The source pool. Every enabled source can supply phrases to any version; splices cross sources at word boundaries. Weights are relative and are renormalised over the enabled set, so turning one off does not change the others' ratio to each other. `primary` is the source the room tone and the drone are sampled from, so silence sounds like one room however many sources the words came from.
